title: Lazar's missing records and the Los Alamos phone book
place_text: Los Alamos National Laboratory, New Mexico

tellings.quote: mistaken or were lying. A 1982 phone book from the lab lists Lazar right there among the other scientists and technicians.

plain: Officials who said there was no record of a man named Bob Lazar at Los Alamos National Laboratory in New Mexico were either mistaken or lying, according to a journalist named George Knapp. Knapp tells Michels that a 1982 phone book from the lab lists Lazar "right there among the other scientists and technicians". If that is right, it would show that Lazar was on the lab's staff list, even though his records are said to be missing. The phone book puts his name in that listing in 1982. What his job was, it does not say.
